import type { DerivationHook } from "@al-ft/midgard-l1-follower";

// A pure derivation: reads facts at the block's slot, no clock, no network.
export const marks: DerivationHook = {
  name: "marks",
  writes: ["marks"],
  apply: async ({ tx, block }) => {
    const at: Date | null = null; // a type mention is not a clock read
    void at;
    await tx.query("INSERT INTO marks (slot) VALUES (?)", [block.point.slot]);
  },
};
